name: Pope Pius II
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1458 to 1464
contribution: Head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 19 August 1458 to his death in 1464.

checks.lead: Pope Pius II (Latin: Pius PP. II, Italian: Pio II), born Enea Silvio Bartolomeo Piccolomini (Latin: Aeneas Silvius Bartholomeus; 18 October 1405 – 14 August 1464), was head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 19 August 1458 to his death in 1464.
